sample_seed: 20261111 + beam*10; proportional stratified blocks in every file
baseline: Current calibrated e- data; original CellID bad-channel mask; HG-LG tail-rich excluded; valid layer9/10 CoG
left_band: 0.7 < N/Nref < 1.35 AND E/N < 0.8 Eref/Nref; Eref and Nref are medians in baseline CoG20, fixed across CoGs
width14: sqrt(sum_layer E_layer Var(short_coordinate)_layer / sum_layer E_layer) <= 14 mm
late_shower: First adjacent pair with each energy>=6*0.305 MeV and >=4 positive unique strips must begin at layer<=6 (zero based)
fit: Before local main-peak fit refined to +-1.5 sigma, same window used after each cut; identical bins. Whole-distribution population RMS/mean also reported.
caveat: Exploratory data-only study: E/N cut sculpts energy; no PID or matched electron-MC efficiency. Position uses shower-derived CoG, so response causality is not established.
validation: All sampled event IDs, energies, Nhit match tail cache; input size/mtime unchanged; independent layer-sum/metric/histogram checks pass.
